# Flash Attention 4
### The 2026 Frontier: Breaking the 1 PFLOPS Single-GPU Barrier

On Blackwell hardware, Tensor Core matrix multiply units run so extraordinarily fast that the normalization step in Softmax—historically a minor fraction of runtime—becomes the dominant bottleneck.

FlashAttention-4 introduces **Adaptive Softmax**:
- Dynamically checks divergence between running block maximums and candidate maximums.
- Skips full re-normalization when numerical differences fall below precision thresholds.
- Overlaps Softmax correction entirely behind asynchronous WGMMA execution pipelines.
- Written using modern Python CuTe-DSL, FA4 is the first kernel to achieve over 1 PFLOPS of sustained attention compute on a single processor.
